hook: Your vines can't be buffed: hang them on one host, buff it, and watch every Climber rise together.
loop: Drag Climbers onto the unit you're about to buff.
Buff that host; every Climber on it rises the same.
Stack a big hub so each gain lands four or five times.

growth.line: Every host gain copies to each Climber on it; Hold and Grand Oak multiply it late.

feel.early: Small sprigs hunting for a Patron to hang on.
feel.mid: Move-then-buff puzzles; hubs and Hold start stacking.
feel.late: Huge hubs, or half your board falling at once.

stars.why: The hub capstone: Climbers on it copy every gain doubled.
Turns the rule on the enemy: rides their biggest unit.
Lets spells and tribe bonuses reach a tribe that can't use them.

card_short.u01: Climber. When played, gives its host +1/+1.
card_short.u02: Patron. Gains Health each turn per Climber next to it.
card_short.u03: Patron with Hold 2: two Climbers can hang here.
card_short.u04: Climber. Gives its host +1/+1 every Start of Turn.
card_short.u05: Climber. Gold each turn while its host is your biggest.
card_short.u06: Climber. Rides the biggest enemy each fight, falling with it.
card_short.u07: Climber. Buffs and spells on your Climbers go to hosts.
card_short.u08: Climber. Turns its Attack into host Health each turn.
card_short.u09: Climber. Its host gains +1/+1 per attack, for the fight.
card_short.u10: Climber. When played, gives a neighbouring non-Climber Hold +1.
card_short.u11: Climber. End of Turn: every host you have gets +1/+1.
card_short.u12: Climber. Selling a Climber gives its stats to its host.
card_short.u13: Patron. Catches Climbers whose host dies next to him.
card_short.u14: Patron, Hold 2. Blooms one Climber each turn, then grows.
card_short.u15: Climber. Each fall gives all your hosts +2/+2 this fight.
card_short.u16: Climber. When played, host grows per different tribe you have.
card_short.u17: Climber. Fight buff to host for each unit she's climbed.
card_short.u18: Climber. Hosted Climbers copy every host's gains, not just theirs.
card_short.u19: Patron, Hold 3. Climbers on it copy its gains doubled.

builds.name: The Great House
builds.line: One back-row hub, Hold raised, four Climbers copying every gain.

builds.name: The Gatecrashers
builds.line: Dodders and Old Man's Beard turn every fall into fight stats.

builds.name: Hangers-on
builds.line: Hang Climbers on another tribe's engine and copy its growth.

liked: Every buff becomes a choice of host: a move-then-buff puzzle each turn.
Truly new: units you can never buff, growing off other tribes' engines.
worries: Watch: Viscum plus Kissing Bough, and golden Grand Oak, may run away.
Ruin Ivy may loop forever as worded; with Harvest Supper it needs testing.
changed: Clearer wording on Cousin Dodder, Ruin Ivy, Viscum and how Grand Oak stacks.
Ruin Ivy now sends tribe bonuses to hosts too, for every Climber to copy.
Hazel Wand counts nearby Climbers; you pick who Blooms off Ivy in Flower.
verdict: Players who love aiming every buff get a bold puzzle: pick a host, buff it, every vine rises.
